notes.title: Join our Discord for a Chance to Win a Steam Key on Launch
notes.content:
[h1]Join our Discord for a Chance to  Win a Steam Key! 🎁[/h1]

[url=https://discord.gg/GANt9ZG94V][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43549363/ed08ddcbca6099cfb591b98d36332203a3394eea.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Join our Discord community and be the first to play Peaceful Lands! As a member of our community, you will have the opportunity to give feedback directly to the developer and help shape the game's future. Don't miss your chance to win a free game key for Peaceful Lands on launch day.[/h3]
[h3]Join now and be a part of this exclusive group![/h3]
